from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalCase(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single legal document to enable matching to judgment results."""
    document_label: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for the document (e.g., '判决文书 1') as provided in the task context")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal document (e.g., '判决书', '裁定书', '决定书', '通知书')")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the case (e.g., 'Inheritance Dispute', 'State Compensation', 'Administrative Litigation')")
    parties: list[str] = Field(description="List of parties named in the document (appellants, respondents, defendants, victims)")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The court name mentioned in the document (e.g., '广州市海珠区人民法院', '辽宁省凤城市人民法院')")
    procedural_stage: str | None = Field(description="The procedural status (e.g., '2nd Instance', 'Retrial', 'Compensation Review', '1st Instance')")
    ruling_action: str | None = Field(description="The core action taken in the ruling (e.g., 'Reject appeal', 'Instruct review', 'Split inheritance', 'Withdraw appeal accepted')")
    key_outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="A short summary of the ruling outcome to match against provided result texts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[LegalCase]
